craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of fitted joinery — utsāha as qualifier meets qualified without loss. Three thinkings counted aloud — all-three-always close; counting thinks (rasa: grammarian wonder). Rejected: (a) uncounting (prose paraphrase) → killed: the count is the content. (b) always→ever → killed: L3 frozen. Read aloud: THE-king's-MAN — THOUGHT-af-ter … ALL-three, AL-ways.

lines: 'The king's man' — thought after, in relation's range,
thought by this; or the first two thought — all three, always.
l4.sanskrit_cite: rājñaḥ puruṣa ityeṣa paścātsaṃbandhagocaraḥ kalpyo'nenātha vā kalpyau pūrvau te sarvathā trayaḥ

reads_against.argmap: How many thinkings? → Three thinkings: whole after relation, or the former two — all told.
c1_essence: Unity without strain for the consciousness-bodied; the worldly one's reflection-object fixed as difference-pithed non-difference-shining (vv10-11).
Mechanics: one thought un-touched, one word uniting many, helping relation admitted, twoness in manyness, two facings, three thinkings, genitive settling unself-lost (vv12-18).
